title: Canonical finite Tate pullback for the section integration square
statement: Use the finite purity datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions] with finite coefficient ring $A$, and the ordinary finite Tate twists with their ordered even shifts [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] [def-amb-vector-integration-charts]. For schemes $T,S$ and any morphism $h:T\to S$, a $k$-structure $a_S:S\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $d\in\mathbf N$, define the canonical Tate pullback isomorphism $Lh^*(A_S(d)[2d])\simeq A_T(d)[2d]$ in the pro-etale derived category. It is the canonical commutation of pullback with the etale-to-pro-etale comparison [def-pur-section-pullback-site-comparisons], followed by realization of the ordinary finite coefficient pullback isomorphism for the ordered $d$-fold shifted Tate tensor, using the roots-and-pure-tensor normalized twist transport [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization]. Pullback means the actual derived inverse image [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. This imposes no finite-type, separatedness, flatness, or positive-rank condition on $h$; at $d=0$ it is the coefficient-unit pullback. No orientation-refinement equation is included.
